summary: 20-month-old child fell into the fast-moving canal near the baseball fields in El Jebel just before 5 p.m.; multi-agency search located the child after about an hour; CPR performed, child transported to a local hospital and pronounced dead there; identity not released.
location: Canal near baseball fields, El Jebel
notes: Responders per ECSO release: Eagle County Sheriff's Office, Basalt Police Department, Pitkin County Sheriff's Office, Colorado State Patrol, Carbondale Fire, Roaring Fork Fire Rescue. Identity not released.
